content: {"episode_id":"ep-05079","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring) was medically necessary for this patient, who has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations that are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings. The monitoring study was indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias that may be contributing to these transient neurological symptoms. Because this service addresses a distinct diagnostic question not answered by standard ECG, we request reconsideration of the CO-97 bundling determination and separate payment of the outstanding balance of 337.79."}
